result.summary: Adds unit tests across four script test suites to cover boundary conditions and untested branches in src/script/script.cpp. The additions test CScript::IsPayToTaproot(), CScript::IsPayToAnchor(), CScript::GetSigOpCount(), CScript::HasValidOps(), CScriptWitness::ToString(), and truncated pushdata parsing in CScript::GetOp().
result.problem: Boundary conditions, truncated input parsing, and specific logic checks in src/script/script.cpp were not tested by the existing test suite, leaving twelve live mutants undetected during mutation testing.
evidence: PR description documents 12 specific mutation failures in src/script/script.cpp that now fail tests, including mutants 2346-2348 in IsPayToTaproot, mutant 2337 in IsPayToAnchor, and mutants in GetSigOpCount and GetScriptOp
Commit messages note that each mutation was applied separately against baseline and verified to fail assertions with the added tests
result.scope_notes: Only touches unit test files (+159 lines across 4 test suites).
result.changed_since_previous: The patch ID changed from a rebase or minor edit, but the scope and target tests across all four test files remain the same.
result.card: Adds unit tests across four script test suites to cover boundary conditions and kill 12 live mutants in src/script/script.cpp identified through mutation testing. The new test cases exercise Taproot and Anchor recognition edge cases, SigOp counting boundary opcodes, opcode limits in HasValidOps, incomplete pushdata byte lengths in GetOp, and witness stack string formatting. Only unit test files are touched.

risk.why: Modifies only unit test suites and does not change any consensus or production script validation code.
